summary.text: Eric Berthel is a Republican who was elected to a fifth term representing Connecticut's 32nd State Senate District in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Before the state senate he represented the 68th House District, serving Watertown, Oakville and Woodbury.
He was born in Brooklyn, New York, has lived in Connecticut since 1976, and holds a bachelor's degree from Manhattanville College and a master's degree from the University of Bridgeport.
He has worked in healthcare communications, public relations, marketing and business development, and has lived in Watertown with his wife Krista since 1998.
